data.action: 坐在喷泉边沿短暂小憩，墨镜挂在衣领
data.description: 拉诺亚魔法大学开满鲜花的中庭喷泉旁，希露菲将墨镜挂在白衬衫衣领上，坐在大理石喷泉沿上享受着片刻的宁静。微风拂过她柔顺的白发，她转头对你露出治愈的微笑——「偶尔像这样什么也不思考地晒晒太阳，感觉心底所有的不安都被洗净了呢。」
data.location: 夏亚魔法大学庭院喷泉
data.promptProse: Seated unhurriedly on the carved marble rim of the Ranoa Magic University courtyard fountain in her white academic tailcoat and ruffled blouse, Sylphiette hooks her dark sunglasses onto her open shirt collar so her eyes remain uncovered. Turning toward the viewer with a calm, restorative smile, she rests one hand lightly on the cool stone edge beside blooming courtyard flowerbeds. Warm afternoon sunlight sparkles off the fountain spray and throws bright water reflections across her sleeve.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 学院庭院喷泉
data.animaCaption: Seated on the marble courtyard fountain rim with her sunglasses hooked at her shirt collar and eyes uncovered, Sylphiette turns toward the viewer with a gentle smile. Afternoon sunlight glints off the fountain water and dapples her white academic coat.
